promotion: NOT_QUALIFIED: no untouched prospective outcomes, four evaluation weeks, one season, only 20 combined Top5 selections per candidate

protocol.design_status: Specified after historical outcomes were known; chronological research replay is not a previously preregistered prospective experiment.
protocol.primary_endpoint: Paired weekly combined Top5 hypothetical -110 unit difference versus original research-score ordering on identical eligible games.
prohibitions: No official historical predictions regenerated or replaced
No postgame personnel/possessions in forecasting features
No fitted thresholds chosen from evaluation weeks
No Confidence 3-5 promotion from these replay results
secondary_endpoints: full-card MAE and RMSE versus frozen model and locked-line forecast
rank overlap and bootstrap selection stability
protocol.top5_rule: Rank within each market and jointly by candidate score; combined five uses at most one market per game. Ties use market then locked-line identity. No market quota. Frozen within-market ranks remain separate; Week5/6 research orders are explicitly retrospective orders of original pregame fields.
protocol.uncertainty: Wilson95 for hit rates with independence caveat; exact paired week-block resampling for four evaluation weeks. Only four clusters and repeated teams prevent strong significance claims. All candidates reported; no tuning after test results or selection of a deployed winner.
